Method of Attack: BEC (business email compromise) scams involving spear-phishing of company employees responsible for approving payments
Use of RATs (Remote Access Trojans) for monitoring and stealing
Impersonation of coworkers, supervisors, or clients/suppliers to divert payments to attacker-controlled bank accounts
Impacted Systems: Company email systems targeted by spear-phishing
At least 50,000 targets as per Interpol analysis
Indicators of Compromise: Possession of more than 800,000 potential victim domain credentials on a suspect's laptop
Monitoring conversations between companies and clients to divert funds
